The Story Behind FlowGroove Hi, I’m a solo developer who’s played in cover bands for 10 years.
The Problem Every rehearsal was the same:
Paper setlists that got lost or coffee-stained Someone forgetting to write down the BPM Arguing over key changes (“Was it F#m or Gm?”) Switching songs taking 5 minutes while the band stood around No sync between my phone, the guitarist’s tablet, and the drummer’s laptop The chaos was killing our vibe. We spent more time organizing than playing.
The Solution So I built FlowGroove.
It’s the tool I wished we had:
✅ Simple — Add songs in 3 seconds
✅ Fast — Real-time sync across all devices (<500ms)
✅ Works offline — No internet? No problem
✅ Auto BPM & key detection — Type the song name, get the data
✅ Stage-ready dark mode — High-contrast for dim venues
Why I Did This No venture capital. No corporate team. Just a developer who plays in a band and got tired of the chaos.
I built FlowGroove between rehearsals and my day job. Late nights. Weekends. Lots of coffee.
Now you can use it too. Free for indie musicians.
The Legal Side FlowGroove is owned and operated by Sounding Doubts - Unipessoal Lda, my company based in Amadora, Portugal.
NIF: 518200736 Address: Amadora, Portugal They handle the legal stuff so I can focus on building.
What’s Next iOS app (working on the Apple Developer License) More integrations (Spotify, YouTube for auto-metadata) Advanced setlist features (transposition, capo support) Band collaboration tools (shared libraries, comments) Support the Development If FlowGroove helps your band, consider supporting development on Ko-fi. Every donation keeps the servers running and the coffee flowing.
Support the Dev on Ko-fi
Thanks for reading. Now go make some music. 🎸
summary: The story of how a solo developer built FlowGroove to solve 10 years of cover band rehearsal chaos.

Frequently Asked Questions General Questions Is FlowGroove really free? Yes. Core features are free forever for indie musicians.
I built this to solve my own band’s problems. If it helps yours too, that’s a win. I accept donations on Ko-fi to keep servers running and coffee flowing.
What’s included in the free tier:
Unlimited setlists Real-time sync across devices Auto BPM & key detection Offline mode Dark theme Who’s behind this? Just me — a solo developer who plays in cover bands.
My company, Sounding Doubts (based in Portugal), handles the legal side. But the code, design, and vision? All one person.
I’ve been in cover bands for 10 years. I know the pain points because I lived them.
Does it work offline? Yes. FlowGroove caches your setlists locally.
No internet at the venue? No problem. Changes sync when you’re back online. Perfect for basement rehears and outdoor gigs.
How offline mode works:
Your setlists are cached on your device You can view and edit them offline Changes sync automatically when you reconnect No data loss, ever Features How fast is the sync? Under 500ms.
Change a song on your phone, it updates on the band’s tablets before you finish strumming the first chord. Tested on 3G, WiFi, and everything in between.
Can I use it for my professional band? Absolutely. FlowGroove works for any band — indie, semi-pro, or full-time.
The free tier covers most use cases. Power users can support development on Ko-fi for advanced features.
What devices does it work on? FlowGroove works on:
Web browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox) Android phones & tablets iOS (coming soon — working on Developer License) Any device with a modern browser How does auto BPM & key detection work? Type a song name → get BPM and key automatically.
We integrate with music databases to fetch metadata. If the API is unavailable, you can always enter data manually. No blocking errors, ever.
Support How can I support development? Donations on Ko-fi keep the project alive:
Support the Dev on Ko-fi
Current goals:
🎯 $50 — Servers & Coffee 🎯 $200 — iOS Developer License I found a bug. What do I do? Report it on GitHub:
Report Bug
Or email me directly with details. I respond within 24 hours.
Can I request a feature? Yes! I love hearing from users.
Request Feature
I can’t promise everything, but I read every request and prioritize what helps the most bands.
Privacy & Legal What data do you collect? Only what’s necessary to make the app work:
Account info (email, name) Your setlists and songs Usage analytics (anonymous, via GA4) I don’t sell data. I don’t track you across the web. Privacy policy is here.
Is my data safe? Yes. Your setlists are backed by Firebase (Google’s cloud platform).
Encrypted in transit (HTTPS) Encrypted at rest Daily backups 99.9% uptime What’s Sounding Doubts? Sounding Doubts - Unipessoal Lda is my company.
Based in Amadora, Portugal (NIF: 518200736). It handles the legal and financial side so FlowGroove can be a proper business, not just a side project.
Still have questions? Contact me and I’ll respond within 24 hours.
summary: Find answers to frequently asked questions about FlowGroove, the free rehearsal sync app for cover bands.
